images.title: The trip board
images.purpose: Give the whole chapter on one picture: a board with 9 small cards, one for each idea of the trip, each drawn simply and countably, for the child to say one idea from each card.
images.composition: A title, then 3 rows of 3 cards read left to right and top to bottom: directions from the Sun, directions on a picture, where you stand, a street map and turns, the metro map, a map with a key, distance on a grid, the shortest route, and a position on a grid.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top centre the title The trip board (bold, 44 px, dark #1F2937, centred at x 728, y 55). Below it 9 cards in 3 rows of 3, read left to right and top to bottom. Each card is a white rounded rectangle 440 px wide and 190 px high with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px); the card left edges are at x 20, 508 and 996 and the card top edges at y 100, 330 and 560. Every card has a title at the top left, a small drawing in the middle and a caption at the bottom. Colours of the drawings: teal #0072B2, amber #E69F00, green #009E73, reddish purple #CC79A7, grey #6B7280, dark #1F2937, with red #D55E00 only for the letter E and the hidden dots. images.takeaway: Every stop of the trip on one board: the Sun and east, the compass on a picture, directions from where you stand, right and left turns, the metro capsule, the key of a map, distance on a grid, the shortest route and a position.
images.description: A board of 9 small cards in 3 rows, one simple picture for each idea of the chapter from directions by the Sun to the position of a place on a grid.
images.context: Concept image for Chapter Revision: Maps and Locations. It gathers the ideas of the pictures in your maths book into one map; every number on a card comes from the chapter's own worked examples and revision lines.
images.teaching_notes: Walk the board in reading order and ask the child to say one idea at each card, then to pick one card to try again. Do not add numbers to the cards; the pictures are only reminders.

image_decisions.why: A board with one small card for each idea of the chapter gives the revision a single picture to walk through.
